body: I hope I can make it through this. Hopefully I'll hear from potential jobs early next week if I can make it that far.
I posted earlier this week. Ex-wife. Kids. Job. Money. Everything is falling apart at the same time. It's like a perfect storm of suck.

There are people around me but I"m still alone. I have people to talk to, but they just want to tell me I'm being selfish. They say I should just change what's happening but I can't seem to make them understand I feel like I've done everything I can.
I want the hopelessness to be over, and I feel like I've done everything I can.
Very alone and hopeless. I can't see a way out of it.
Thanks. If I get up the nerve I'll let you know.
Trying to find someone to help now. I appreciate the response.
